title: Begin within Hukam
summary: The day does not need to come under your control before it can be met truthfully.
takeaway: You can meet what arrives without pretending you authored it.
lifeApplication: Before reacting, name one thing already here that you need to stop resisting.

source.shortMeaning: Everything stands inside Hukam, not outside it.
source.lifeApplication: Release the demand that peace must wait for total control.

evidence.coreClaim: Everything stands inside Hukam, not outside it.
evidence.turn: Everything stands within Hukam, and ego thins when this is seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reacting, name one thing already here that you need to stop resisting.
